book.name: YOHANE
book.title: Yohane Yeng Yesuac Siduc Gombung Ohoec

content: Farisaio yeni Yesuac yofi negenggec, “Yeng habu meyunuma doku nadzicyemmeu Yohaneac habu kpetea ferahede.”
Nga Yesu yengenaoc ngicngac doku mi nadzicyemmeu medacfora yeneng doku nadzicyemmegec.
Nga Yesungo yoac ifi negemma Yudaia bangec wama Gariraia bangecfu monggoc dzigeneec.
Ihai kemma Samaria bangec ferecgebeso amma Samariaac taong mong kpara Sika, ihai kensikeec. Sika taong imoc Yakobongo medaha Yosefeac bangec desimiec, imocac wegenac tarec.
Anu Yesungo Yakoboac dokuteng tarecfu, imohai sing kengkecma kuha kpac anu dokuteng imocac tegiau mama tarec. Tacmanu 12 kiroc isoc anec.
Anu medacfora yeni yaka bummegecdeac taonnu kemmagec samariangac mongngo doku fiudeac hau Yesungo yofi edeec, “Doku mehana neba.”
Ifi deu ngacngo deec, “Ge yudangicngo dafi samariangac nearu dokuac denec?” Yudangicngac yeni samariangicngac yenigoc emenecngina mi feecac ngacngo ifi deec.
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi edeec, “Ge Anutu haringaac hania nga merang dokuac kpesigende, imoc negentegecma kpesimibang debac yeng doku kekehagoc gembac.”
Ifi deu ngacngo deec, “Kebu, ge doku finadeac wiacga kpac nga dokuteng imoc herea anu doku kekehagoc dahacnac finade?
Bangecnina Yakobongo dokuteng yomoc menemmeec. Geng ye ferahenec me? Ye yengena nga medacfora amma ramaburumakafora, yeni doku yomohanac nekecgec.”
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi meremmiec, “Ngicngac doku yomoc neandae, yeni sasawango dokuac monggoc ayemmeande.
Nga mong ye neng doku miba neude, yeng dokuac monggoc mi ammibesande. Nga doku mibade, imocngo yearu dokukiwa sike sikea fingecma kekecseri meficgemiude.”
Ifi deu ngacngo deec, “Kebu, ge doku imoc nenna nema dokuac monggoc mi anembeso nga doku fibadeac yomohai monggoc mi habesare.”
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi meremmiec, “Ge kemma ewega dena haec.”
Ifi deu ngacngo deec, “Ni ewena kpac.” deu Yesungo yofi edeec, “Ni ewena kpac, ge fora denec.
Ge ngic 5 bic meyununec nga ngic yofinenggac mena ngerahafoc kecdape, ye geac ewega kpac.”
Ifi deu ngacngo deec, “Kebu, ge profete, imoc gentegecduae.
Kisicfocnina yeneng tikibuma yomohai Anutu afehekecgec. Anu ngeneng yofi deandae, ‘Yerusareng, imohaisac Anutu afehebesonga.’”
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi edeec, “Ngac negensinnuna, naso mong wegeneude, imohai ngicngac ngeneng tikibuma yomohai nga Yerusarennu Anutu monggoc mi afehegecde.
Ngeni wiac hania mi negentegecdae, imoc numumidae. Ebicfunac mesi mesi nga komoc kpegecdeac kuc, imoc yudangic nenearunac fingerec nga Anutu negengireckema numumima kecdimbe.
Naso mong hama kecde nga bic hadac, imohai ine dedengerec ngicngac fora, yeni ongaasungina forango Manggac dengeregecde. Manggacngo nunumu areng ifia yeneac negenu ngereeude.
Anutu ye Asu. Imocac amma ngicngac dengerebesonga dema ongaasungo nga faka forau dengerebisia.”
Ifi deu ngacngo deec, “Messia, kpara mong Kristo deandae, ye fingerudeac dedea, imoc negenduae. Yeng hama wiac sasawa dekperaginemmeude.”
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi edeec, “Yoac edeguduae, imoc ni.”

Ifi demanu medacfora yeneng amaunac dzigene hagec. Hama Yesungo ngacgoc yoac denegeng anocac hemma kerectegec anggec. Amma mongngo yofi mi kpesimiec, “Ge noc wiacac kpesiminec me yegoc noc wiacac dedape?”
Anu ngacngo Yesuac yoac negemma enanga wama amau dzigene kemma amafora edeyunuec,
“Ngeni hama henggec. Ngic mong ni faka anai meai, imoc seng deficnudacde. Ye Messia gedang?”
Ifi deu yeneng taong wama Yesuaru hagec.
Anu medacfora yeneng yaka neudeac yofi degec, “Rabbi, ge yaka nena.”
Ifi degec yeng yofi edeyunuec, “Yaka fenende, imoc ngeni mi negendae.”
Ifi deu medacfora yenaocngoc denegeng amma degec, “Ngic mongngo yaka meha migec nedac gedang.”
Ifi degec Yesungo yofi edeyunuec, “Suenuec, yeac enac tofohoma uaya mekecma mesibade, imocngo yakana ande.
Ngeni yofi deandae, ‘Afo 4 wisickeuguc semeng fora anude.’ Neng yoac mong deba negenggec, ngeni kicngina fima uau henggec, yaka bic fora amma kpekpauc fede.
Ifi anu heihomec nga kpememengic yeri yerahafoc ubangerec negenecdeac kpememengicngo uayaac bung mema kekecseriac fora ifingoc mekpedzuc anude.
Nga, ‘Ngic mongngo wiac homeru mong ye fora mekpedzuc anude.’ yoac ifi deandae, imocac foranoc fingecde.
Ngic goa yeneng ua megec ua imocac fora fingerec. Nga ngeni heihomec mi ammagec ni suengunuba fora mekpedzuc ambisia. Ngeneng yeneac ua torokpema tigec enec.”
Samariangacngo Yesuac yofi dekperagiyemmeec, “Yeng ni faka anai meai, imoc seng deficnudacde.” ifi deecac taong imohacnac samaria ngicngac yenearunac homacngo Yesu negensinggegec.
Imocac amma samariangicngac Yesuaru kemma yeng yenigoc kefudeac heitaigec. Heitaigec yeng negengyemmema wenac yohockang yenigoc kefec.
Yesungo ihai kecmanu homacngo yombong yeac yoacac amma negensinggema
ngac edegec, “Neni warac geac siducac amma negensinggeding. Nga yaguc nenaoc yeac enacfunac yoara negemma negensinggedimbe. Amma gennoc bangecngic sasawa neneac memengerec ngic, imoc negendimbe.”
Anu uameme yohockang wisickeu Yesungo Samaria bangec wama Gariraia bangecfu kenec.
Ye ihai kemma yengenaac yofi dekperagiemeec, “Profete mongngo yengena bangecfu kefu ngicngac yeneng eweheihei mong mi ammigecde.”
Anu gariraiangic yeni makekenggac nasou Yerusareng taonnu kenggec Yesungo faka sasawa meu henggecac amma Gariraia bangecfu kenu amafora yeneng ubangerecgoc heitaigec.
Heitaigec Yesungo Kana taong Gariraia bangecfu doku merennu waing anec, ihai monggoc dzigene kenec. Kenu ihai ngictauac kia mong haec, yeac medacngo Kafanaung taonnu hafei feec.
Nga kiango Yesu Yudaia bangecfunac dzigenema Gariraia bangecfu hade, ifi negemma yearu kemma medaha mengereudeac edeec, nocac medaha homebeso anec.
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi edeec, “Ngeni faka kuhagoc nga faka morora mi hemma eng mi negensinggegecde.”
Ifi deu kiango deec, “Kebu, ge bic hana, medacna homebeso ande.”
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi edeec, “Ge kenna, Medacga bic ngereedac kecde.” ifi deu ngic ye Yesuac yoac negensinggema dzigene kenec.
Dzigene kememanungoc wanacngicfora yeneng hama sinnu meficgema edegec, “Medacga bic ngereedac kecde.”
Ifi edegec, ye ngereec, imocac nasoyombonggac kpesiyemmeu yeneng degec, “Worang hadzing 1 kiroc, imohai sebia nomanedac.”
Ifi degec mamango negensiec, “Yesungo naso imohainoc suenuma dedac, ‘Medacga ye bic ngereedac kecde.’” Ifi negemma siduc edeyunuu ye nga wiacfora yeni Yesu negensinggegec.
Yesungo Yudaia bangecfunac Gariraia bangecfu dzigene hama negensinggegecdeac faka kuhagoc meu imocngo naso yohockang anec.
